parse_p <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, \":\", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) "'!= 2L) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
  if (anyNA(vals) || any(vals < 0) || sum(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  vals[[1]] / sum(vals)
}

make_scope <- function(dat, lo, hi) {
  fit_models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2), data=dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2) + I(p''^3), data=dat),
    spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  rows <- list()
  for (model_name in names(fit_models)) {
    m <- fit_models[[model_name]]
    n <- length(residuals(m))
    k <- length(coef(m))
    rss <- sum(residuals(m)''^2)
    sigma <- summary(m)$sigma
    aic <- AIC(m)
    bic <- BIC(m)
    adjr2 <- summary(m)$adj.r.squared
    grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=20001L)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata=data.frame(p=grid))
    idx <- which.max(pred)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      model = model_name,
      n = n,
      k = k,
      rss = rss,
      sigma = sigma,
      AIC = aic,
      BIC = bic,
      adjR2 = adjr2,
      opt_p = grid[[idx]],
      opt_pred = pred[[idx]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$scope <- attr(dat, "scope")
  out
}
